summary: Telefonica Brasil filed a Form 6-K announcing Board approval of Interest on Capital (IoC)—a Brazilian mandatory dividend equivalent—totaling R$230 million (gross), R$0.0719738 per share, with 17.5% withholding tax, netting R$0.0593784 per share. The IoC is booked against 2026 mandatory dividends, payable by April 30, 2027, to holders of record June 26, 2026, after which shares trade ex-IoC. Amounts may adjust if the ongoing buyback program reduces the share base. This is a routine capital return, not an extraordinary event. Watch for any buyback-driven per-share recalculation.
